text: In West Berlin the spy Mark comes home to find his wife Anna wants to leave him, and their marriage [tears into blows and self-inflicted wounds|wrong|cruelty at home]. Their young son Bob is left alone and unkempt, while his teacher Helen [looks exactly like Anna but with green eyes|threat|impostors and doubles]. Anna keeps a derelict apartment, and what she tends there, [a tentacled creature among dismembered corpses|images|corpses and body parts], begins to [take on a shape of its own|wants|taking someone's place].
